subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the M54 across all 1 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The M54 is one of the fewer applications we work on — it was fitted to the Z4 during the first-generation E85/E86 production run from 2002 to 2006, across 2.2L, 2.5L and 3.0L capacities.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals, and timing chain components where required — all inspected and measured to OEM tolerances.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the M54 across its Z4 applications. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed M54 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
